name: Albumin
summary: Albumin is the main protein in blood plasma. It is made by the liver and helps keep fluid inside blood vessels and carry hormones, drugs and nutrients.

high.meaning: A high albumin usually means the blood is more concentrated than usual, most often from not drinking enough fluid.
commonCauses: Tight tourniquet or long standing before the blood draw

low.meaning: A low albumin can reflect inflammation, liver or kidney problems, or not getting enough protein.
commonCauses: Protein loss through the kidneys or gut

sources.title: An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan
